purpose: Tab5 8bit parallel + independently powered Tang Primer20K Core DDR3/accelerator; Linux and GPU use separate software/bitstreams. HDMI is optional minimum success.
findings: On reviewed local development branch Linux transport is mock only; published main has no physical FPGA transport driver. DeviceTree/PARLIO implementation is not established in either reviewed version.
GPU board profile is explicitly unverified; actual link RTL is echo/CRC/timeout, not complete DDR3 GPU board top.
Research memory repository is planning material and cannot substitute for Linux review.
Initial 1MHz is a fabrication/bringup condition; 40MHz/40MBps architecture target is not validated by this evaluation.
Core onboard DDR3 layout is retained; official factory DDR test is a bringup reference. Complete Core DDR3 SI/RTL and final GPU functionality are not simulated.
Carrier GPIO/net assignments remain unchanged; firmware weak drive/SLOW, startup ARM guard, brownout reinitialization and inverted HPD must be reflected during related-project implementation.
related_repository_modifications: No source changes in related repositories; handoff required before enabling their unverified board profiles.

published_main_recheck.finding: Published main emphasizes explicit FPGA DDR3 tiled/spill/compute use and separate GPU bitstreams. Initial8bitPARLIO remains a proposal, physical driver/DMA unimplemented. Active local development branch c1cd5e4 additionally contains mock preparation; do not conflate branch implementation statuses. No changed pin or power requirement found.
published_main_recheck.implementation_search: git ls-tree origin/main tools linux/dts: no FPGA physical transport driver found; tools/fpga-link exists only on reviewed development branch.
